title: Dual peripheral driver (75452B)

sources.document: TI The Interface Circuits Data Book 2nd ed. 1974, Series 55450B/75450B dual peripheral drivers (bulletin DL-S 7311798, Sep 1973, tentative data sheet)

functions.text: Positive-NAND: output transistor on (low) only when A and B are both high; otherwise off (high, external pull-up).

electrical.notes: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Abs max output voltage 30 V, output current 300 mA. Off-state IOH max 100 uA at VOH 30 V. VOL 0.25/0.4 V at 100 mA, 0.5/0.7 V at 300 mA. Inputs VIH 2 V, VIL 0.8 V, IIL -1.6 mA.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, IO ~200 mA, CL 15 pF, RL 50 ohm
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, IO ~200 mA, CL 15 pF, RL 50 ohm

timingLimits.text: tTLH 5 typ / 8 max ns, tTHL 7 typ / 12 max ns

unknown: Recommended operating conditions give no output current; only the 300 mA absolute maximum and the 100/300 mA VOL test points are printed, so IOL is null.
